job.title: Full Stack Developer (m/f/d) Webshop Team, Bucharest (Romania)
job.email_subject: Application: Full Stack Developer Webshop Team – Java, microservices, CI/CD
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your webshop team needs developers who own features end to end – I have built and run large e-commerce platforms with Java, Spring and JavaScript for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– REST APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends; backend and frontend features
– Code reviews, design patterns and JUnit test suites
– CI/CD deployment cycles with Git; SQL refactoring for lower latency

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss how the setup with the Bucharest team can work. My CV and cover letter are attached. My profile combines technical depth with close work alongside business teams, and I would bring exactly this experience to your team. Could we schedule a short call in the coming days?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191

tailoring.headline: Full Stack Developer – eCommerce Webshop | Java, Microservices, JavaScript & CI/CD
tailoring.summary: Full stack developer with 5+ years designing, building and maintaining large e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, RESTful APIs and JavaScript, with Git, CI/CD deployment cycles, object-relational databases and SQL query performance tuning. Builds headless APIs for Progressive Web App frontends, ensures code quality through code reviews and JUnit test suites and works closely with designers, architects, testers and product owners in Scrum teams. Uses AI tools extensively in development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Tchibo is one of Germany's ten largest eCommerce companies and gives its webshop team full ownership of microservices from frontend to cloud. That end-to-end responsibility, combined with code reviews, TDD and dedicated innovation time, matches how I like to build e-commerce software, and lets me bring my experience with large commerce platforms into a team that keeps reinventing itself.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I applied for Full Stack Developer in the Tchibo Webshop Team: 5+ years building large e-commerce platforms (Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, JavaScript, CI/CD) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Full Stack Developer Webshop Team
en.hook: Tchibo's webshop team owns the entire customer journey – frontend, backend and the microservices behind it. That end-to-end ownership is what I have practised for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I design, build and maintain large e-commerce platforms with Java, Spring and JavaScript, from headless APIs for PWA frontends to deployment and production.

bullets.label: End-to-end development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data, and built REST APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Code excellence
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, applied design patterns and built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain code quality and coverage.

bullets.label: Microservices & SQL
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Git & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on the cloud platform within agile DevOps workflows, using Git, Docker and Kubernetes environments.

en.logistics: I enjoy agile teams where developers, designers and testers solve problems together. I am currently based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period; I would be glad to discuss how the setup with the Bucharest team can work. I look forward to a conversation about Tchibo's webshop.
